items.explanation: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 孟子 briefly, for example with an identifying noun phrase.
It would be more natural to say 每天从早到晚, because 每天 already shows that this happened repeatedly.
From early to late, the playing takes place at the cemetery, so use 在墓地 rather than 去墓地.
It would be more natural to say 玩儿 here. Delete the extra 玩 to avoid repetition.
